products.summary: Carefully selected American Ginseng (Panax quinquefolius) slices with a clean appearance, natural botanical character, and mild, slightly sweet taste. The dried slices are conveniently packed in a clear sealed jar and can be steeped with hot water for everyday herbal tea preparation or combined with other botanical ingredients such as goji berries and chrysanthemum. Each bottle contains 60 g. Slice thickness, net weight, jar size, packaging, labels, and private-label branding can be customized according to customer requirements. OEM/ODM and bulk supply services are available.
